description: Loads a semantic modeling source and presents a modeling editor workspace. TreeGrouping (Fáze 12) passes the model tree's structure through: Auto (the default) renders the ParentId hierarchy when at least one element resolves to a valid parent and keeps the SemanticType groups otherwise; the editor owns the hierarchy's CollapsedElementIds state across tree remounts. On the docked layouts (tablet/desktop, resolved from the editor's own container) the workspace renders through the core TmEditorShell. On the TABLET band (768-1199 of container) the shell presents its TabletPanelPresentation.Overlay: the model tree is an overlay drawer, the inspector a non-modal side sheet, at most ONE open at a time, and the "Panels" tab row (the same test ids as the compact row) acts as the visibility switch (aria-expanded toggles; Preview closes both). A tree selection opens the inspector sheet, and the tree's "Insert into preview" action (WCAG 2.5.7 non-drag alternative to dragging) reuses the element through the preview's existing drop path at the viewport center — TmModelingDiagramPreview.InsertAtViewportCenterAsync — honoring AllowNodeDrop. On the docked layouts (tablet/desktop, resolved from the editor's own container) the workspace renders through the core TmEditorShell: Header (title, state badge, the provider/notation/viewpoint group), Left (model tree), Canvas (diagram preview with the collapsible Issues dock under it — header with a neutral count, aria-expanded toggle, the collapsed state is session-owned), Right (inspector with Properties | Source tabs — only the active tab renders its body, a stale source marks the Source tab with a neutral indicator and the tab drives the editor's reload) and StatusBar. The layout thresholds are the DiagramEditor pair (mobile below 768px of container, tablet 768-1199, desktop from 1200); below the editor's own mobile threshold the pre-redesign compact workspace (panel tabs, one visible panel) renders until the mobile phase. The docked shell is not pinned to the editor's resolved mode: an Auto shell measures its own container, so the nested TmDiagramEditors (preview + open-editor dialog) resolve from their own containers. The preview's "Open in editor" action opens the generated document in a core TmModal viewport dialog (scrim, TmFocusScope focus trap, Escape) sized ~90vw x 90vh on the desktop AND the tablet band (the near-fullscreen footprint keys off the editor container, not the viewport); the dialog header owns the document title (falling back to the "Open in editor" label) and the close button, and the embedded TmDiagramEditor keeps every panel with ToolbarPreset=Full and ShowTitle=false (one header). Changes keep propagating live to the preview (G8), so the scrim is not a close affordance.

parameters.name: AllowModelEditing
parameters.description: Turns the inspector editing mode on (Fáze 14). Editing is active only when an IModelingModelWriter is registered for the effective provider key OR an OnModelChanged delegate is bound — otherwise the inspector stays read-only (MO2).

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: Whether model tree elements can be reused by dropping them onto the preview canvas.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the editor root.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The editor's block size (a CSS length only - e.g. 600px, 100%, 100dvh). Null keeps the stylesheet contract min(768px, 100vh - 32px) (the token pair on .tm-modeling-editor). When set, the editor renders exactly this height (the token min-height floor is dropped with an inline min-height: 0) - the host owns the sizing. The shell inside fills the box.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The mode rendered before the first measurement of an Auto editor (SSR, prerender and the first frame). Desktop markup degrades acceptably through the data-layout CSS.

parameters.name: LayoutBreakpoints
parameters.description: Per-instance thresholds for the editor's own container. Null keeps the Modeling pair (mobile below 768px of container, tablet 768-1199, desktop from 1200 - the same pair as TmDiagramEditor). Only the markup branch moves; stylesheets keep the shared literals.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the editor resolves its presentation. Auto (default) measures the editor's own container with the shared observer (mobile below 768px of container, tablet 768-1199, desktop from 1200 - the same pair as TmDiagramEditor, so hosts embedding both flip them together); a forced mode renders that layout without any measurement so tests and hosts can pin it. The docked layouts render through the core TmEditorShell - an Auto shell measures its own container, so the nested TmDiagramEditors (preview + open-editor dialog) resolve from their own containers; the compact layout keeps the panel-tab workspace.

parameters.name: ModelLoaderOverride
parameters.description: Optional loader used by host pages or tests to supply a model without registering a provider.

parameters.name: NotationKey
parameters.description: Optional notation key passed to the selected provider and generator.

parameters.name: OnDiagramGenerated
parameters.description: Callback raised after a model is loaded and converted into a diagram document.

parameters.name: OnModelChanged
parameters.description: Raised after every committed field edit with the change set of that commit and the current model. Binding it alone (without a writer) makes the host own the persistence.

parameters.name: OnNodeDropped
parameters.description: Callback raised after a model tree element is reused as a new preview node.

parameters.name: OnNotationChanged
parameters.description: Callback raised when the editor notation selection changes.

parameters.name: OnOpenInEditor
parameters.description: Callback raised when the user opens the generated diagram in the full diagram editor.

parameters.name: OnProviderChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the editor provider selection changes (semantics of OnNotationChanged for the provider).

parameters.name: OnSaveCompleted
parameters.description: Raised after a completed save (success, conflict or failure).

parameters.name: OnViewpointChanged
parameters.description: Callback raised when the editor viewpoint selection changes.

parameters.name: PersistKey
parameters.description: Overrides the localStorage key the docked shell persists user-resized panel widths under. Null (default) derives the key from TestIdPrefix - {TestIdPrefix}-modeling-editor, or plain modeling-editor without a prefix - so two editors on one page share persisted widths only when they share the prefix. Set it explicitly to namespace (or intentionally share) the saved layout per instance.

parameters.name: ProviderDisplayName
parameters.description: Optional display-name resolver for the provider options and the provider chip (review fix, phase 3). Receives the raw provider key and returns the text to show; when the callback is null (or returns nothing) the raw key itself is shown. The demo maps the keys to localized names; a host may resolve them from its own registry.

parameters.name: ProviderKey
parameters.description: Provider key used to select the semantic model provider. Null or empty values render the empty state.

parameters.name: ProviderKeyChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user picks a provider in the header selector; enables @bind-ProviderKey. The editor reloads the model with the selected provider.

parameters.name: SaveMode
parameters.description: How committed edits reach the writer: Manual (default) aggregates the pending change set until SaveModelChangesAsync; Immediate calls the writer after every field commit.

parameters.name: ShowPreviewLegend
parameters.description: Whether the preview renders the notation legend card. Default true — the legend is part of the editor's contract from Fáze 15 on (a host that wants the pre-Fáze-15 look passes false). The mobile band shows the legend as a "⋯" sheet instead of the card.

parameters.name: ShowProviderSelector
parameters.description: Renders a labeled "Provider" select in the editor header that lists every registered IModelingModelProvider (MO3). Default false keeps the pre-selector behavior: the provider stays a labeled value chip and remains host-owned through ProviderKey.

parameters.name: TreeGrouping
parameters.description: How the model tree structures its elements (Fáze 12 pass-through). Auto (the default) renders the ModelingElementDto.ParentId hierarchy when at least one element resolves to a valid parent and keeps the SemanticType groups for flat models — a model without ParentId looks and behaves exactly as before.

parameters.name: ViewpointKey
parameters.description: Optional viewpoint key passed to the selected provider and used to choose the initial model view.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__state
cssClasses.description: Wrapper around the state TmBadge next to the editor title (variant by state).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__status-item
cssClasses.description: One separated status item; the first carries the state icon (and the last-loaded time when the model carries metadata, MO3).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__status-icon
cssClasses.description: Leading status icon (check/alert/clock by state), aria-hidden.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__context
cssClasses.description: Right-aligned header group wrapping the provider field/chip and the TmModelingViewSelector; wraps as a whole under the title and becomes a single-column grid below 48rem (review fix, phase 3).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__field
cssClasses.description: Labeled header field (label above the select) hosting the provider selector when ShowProviderSelector is on; may shrink to its token minimum inside the wrapping context group (review fix, phase 3).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__open-editor-modal
cssClasses.description: Class on the open-editor TmModal overlay root; sizes the modal panel to ~90vw x 90vh on the desktop and to a near-fullscreen panel below 48rem.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__open-editor-body
cssClasses.description: Dialog body wrapper filling the TmModal body; hosts the embedded diagram editor.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__open-editor-diagram
cssClasses.description: The embedded TmDiagramEditor inside the dialog body; fills the body height.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__shell
cssClasses.description: Class applied to the core TmEditorShell root on the docked layouts; fills the editor box and neutralizes the shell's generic header/status/canvas padding so the modeling chrome owns its own rhythm.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__canvas-body
cssClasses.description: The docked canvas surface: a grid with the preview row (minmax(0,1fr)) and the issues dock row (auto). Also the focusWithin surface containing the open-editor trigger and dialog.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__canvas-body--issues-open
cssClasses.description: Modifier rendered while the Issues dock is expanded; the dock row becomes a token clamp (min 12rem, preferred 38%, cap 20rem of the canvas region) so the list scrolls inside the dock and the preview keeps its row.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__inspector
cssClasses.description: The inspector wrapper inside the shell's right dock; carries the frozen modeling-inspector-panel test id and the Properties | Source TmTabs (sticky tab strip).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__history-btn
cssClasses.description: Inspector header undo/redo button (with the keyboard hint in its title).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__editing-alert
cssClasses.description: Wrapper of the save/conflict feedback alerts above the inspector.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__conflict-reload
cssClasses.description: The conflict alert's localized "Reload" action (asks for confirmation before discarding pending changes).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__discard-actions
cssClasses.description: Confirm/Cancel row of the discard-confirmation modal.
